description: A boat entered in the series with no finish and no code in a race is scored DNC for that race, one more than the boats entered.
citation: RRS 2025-2028 A2.2: 'If a boat has entered any race in a series, she shall be scored for the whole series.' A10: 'DNC Did not start; did not come to the starting area.' A5.2 scores it one more than the number of boats entered in the series. Recording convention (fixtures/scoring/README.md): a boat with nothing recorded in a race did not come to the starting area.
working: R1: A 1, B 2, C 3, D 4; E has no finish and no code, so DNC 6. R2: E 1, A 2, B 3, C 4; D has nothing recorded, so DNC 6. R3: B 1, A 2, E 3, D 4, C 5.
E missed R1 and is still scored for it (A2.2). No two nets are equal: A, B, E, C, D.
